question: The 37° C temperature is equal to nearly:
solution: The correct answer is __**98.6° F.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ ** __ • All temperatures are related to each other by the following relationship – **frac{{F - 32^circ }}{9} = (C)/(5) = frac{{K - 273}}{5}** Calculation:__ Given: Temperature = 37°C, frac{{F - 32^circ }}{9} = (C)/(5) frac{{F - 32^circ }}{9} = (37)/(5) 5(F - 32°) = 333
